jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description: 3Pillar is an AI transformation partner on a mission to help enterprises build the AI\-native products and intelligent agents that will define the next era of business. With teams across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia, we work with the most ambitious companies in financial services, healthcare, media, and technology — helping them move faster, modernize boldly, and compete on their own terms. Our HelixAI platform and Helix Pods delivery model put our engineers at the center of real agentic transformation — doing work that is open, portable, and built to last. We are building the future of enterprise AI. Accomplished Tech Visionary: Elevate your expertise to new heights at 3Pillar, the premier destination for trailblazing professionals like yourself. Picture collaborating with industry leaders and serving as a critical bridge between stakeholders and an elite engineering team building technology that advances healthcare globally. Your role goes beyond gathering requirements; you will shape the direction of our client platform by transforming complex clinical research needs into actionable engineering deliverables. Join us and spearhead the charge toward a product future that transcends the ordinary. You will be focused on eliciting and documenting business requirements from stakeholders, facilitating agile ceremonies, and ensuring that development teams have clear, testable, and well\-prioritized specifications to deliver against. ### **Requirement** * Facilitate effective communication with client project stakeholders regarding project status, requirements clarity, and delivery recommendations. * Elicit, document, and manage business requirements from product owners and stakeholders. * Translate requirements into well\-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications in Jira/Confluence. * Facilitate backlog grooming, sprint planning, and stakeholder review sessions in collaboration with engineering and QA. * Conduct gap analyses and workflow mapping to identify process improvements on the BX platform. * Support UAT (user acceptance testing) planning, test script preparation, and stakeholder sign\-off. * Produce clear documentation including BRDs, process flows, data dictionaries, and use case diagrams. * Engage in agile software development including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, team retrospectives, and governance activities. ### **Responsibilities** **Experience/expertise in the following areas specified below:**Elicit and document requirements from business and technical stakeholders in a software product environment Author user stories, acceptance criteria, BRDs, and process documentation to a high standard Facilitate agile ceremonies and manage backlog priorities in Jira and Confluence Support UAT planning and execution, serving as a liaison between business and QA teams **Must\-Have Skills \& Tools: Methodologies:** Agile/Scrum Tools: Jira, Confluence **Slack/Teams Deliverables:** User stories, BRDs, process flow diagrams, data dictionaries, use cases **Good to Have Skills:** Experience in clinical trials, healthcare IT, or regulated software environments (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11\) 3\+ years of business analysis experience in a software product or professional services environment. Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences. Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills. English proficiency.### **Desired** CBAP or equivalent business analysis certification. Familiarity with API concepts and ability to review technical specifications. Experience in a multi\-vendor delivery model. Excellent problem\-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards challenges.### **What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?** Imagine a flexible work environment – whether it’s the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote\-first approach. You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. We’re big on your well\-being – as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country\-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best. Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities – across projects, offerings, and industries. We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting\-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity – globally and locally. Join us and be a part of a global tech community! \\uD83C\\uDF0D\\uD83D\\uDCBC Check out our Linkedin site and Careers page to learn more about what it’s like to be part of our \#oneteam! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Member of GTM Staff
jobs.description: **About 8090** The Software Industrial Complex has evolved into a bloated, expensive ecosystem that burdens enterprises with unnecessary complexity and inefficiency. Co\-founded and led by Chamath Palihapitiya, we are building a Software Factory that delivers fully\-managed and hosted software purpose\-built for each customer. **About the role** At 8090\.ai, we're scaling our sales team to capture a two large market opportunities: replacing legacy software, and building custom software \- for both the enterprise and the public sectors. We need Members of GTM Staff to own end\-to\-end complex enterprise deal cycles within one or two of our five commercial verticals: Manufacturing, Life Sciences/Med Devices, Financial Services, Technology Media and Telecom, and Insurance. This is not a role for someone who needs a playbook handed to them; it requires high agency, near\-complete autonomy, and carries substantial revenue generation responsibilities. If successful, you will grow into a Senior Member of GTM Staff role and a path toward leading a vertical at 8090\. We've built a Software Factory that brings control, consistency, and quality to the Software Development Lifecycle (the SDLC). On the 8090 Enterprise team, we use Software Factory to modernize legacy technologies for customers, and to build bespoke software solutions for the Fortune 2000\. We price our modernization and custom software work on a deliverables (modernization) or milestone basis (custom) and our customers tell us this is unique. Our technical teams are world\-class, the tools we have available to us are incredible, and the opportunity to drive meaningful impact for our customers is nearly unlimited. **Location** On\-site Redwood City or Remote\* **Responsibilities** * End\-to\-end deal cycles: prospecting \> discovery \> business case creation \> co\-author lightweight product requirements documents \> scope with sales engineering/CTO \> lead negotiations and execute on contracts \> maintain executive relationships as projects go live. * Building relationships with customer executives and the creation of high\-quality business cases that clearly articulate problems to solve or opportunities to unlock that have asymmetric upside (ROI) for the customer. * Running technical discovery with cross\-functional teams (Technical Product Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and our customer teams) to assess workflows, cost structures, data maturity, and AI readiness. Support for the product requirement document (PRD) development or legacy system assessment processes that enable us to scope and size deals. * Execution of complex, seven\-figure TCV deals, done in half the time of traditional enterprise sales cycles. * Multi\-threaded executive engagement across CEO, CFO, CIO, COO, CDO, Operations, IT, Transformation, and Finance. * The development of tools (agents, functioning software) that complement our sales chip (we aspire to run 8090 like a computer) and enable us to run the business at seemingly impossible per\-employee efficiency levels. * Evangelize 8090 through executive workshops, industry events, and analyst engagement. **Required Skills** * A founder\-like mindset: high bias for action, persistence, grit, and comfort with ambiguity. You are high\-agency: you find the path, you don’t wait for one. * 5\-10 years of enterprise sales experience selling large\-scale SaaS, data, or AI transformation programs. You do not need to have led teams; you need to have carried a number and beaten it. * A track record of punching above your weight: you’ve built trusted relationships with executives well senior to your title (CIOs, CFOs, COOs) and they’ll act as references to that effect. * A track record of closing seven\-figure TCV deals with complex, multi\-stakeholder buying processes involving C\-suite, Finance, Legal, and InfoSec. * Genuine curiosity about one or two of our verticals: you’ve sold into them, or you’re hungry to earn the secrets of how those customers run their businesses and how they buy. * Strong commercial and deal\-craft instincts: pricing conversations, negotiation, and creative deal structures don’t scare you. * Working fluency in AI/LLM concepts and the SDLC. You are a full\-stack sales person and want to build.Eager to roll up your sleeves, get involved in the details, work hard, and build something great **Expected compensation (US\-based employees):** $175K\-$250K annual salary \+ stock and/or stock option awards \+ benefits \+ commission. We offer competitive pay and benefits. Compensation may vary depending on many individualized factors, including location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Details of the compensation package, including benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401K, …), will be provided if and when a candidate receives an offer of employment. **Employment Eligibility\-** This position is only open to candidates who can provide sufficient documentation establishing employment eligibility in the United States of America and to **provide satisfactory proof of your identity as required by U.S. law**. A further condition of your employment is satisfactory completion of a credit and/or criminal background check. **We do not provide new work visa sponsorship.** **Equal Opportunity Statement \-** 8090 is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran status and disability status, protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Structural Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview:** Our client, an engineering firm specializing in renewable energy, water, and environmental solutions, is seeking a **Senior Structural Engineer** to manage projects, lead multidisciplinary teams, and support the design of hydroelectric, fisheries, and water resource infrastructure. This role combines technical design and project leadership responsibilities, including structural analysis of concrete and steel systems, coordination across engineering disciplines, and direct client interaction throughout project execution. The Senior Structural Engineer will oversee multiple projects, ensure quality and consistency in deliverables, and contribute to team development and long\-term client relationships. **This is a full\-time position open to candidates located in Portland, OR; Redmond, WA; Essex, CT; Falmouth, ME; and Pittsfield, ME.** **Pay range: $112,000 \- $170,000 DOE** **Benefits:*** Comprehensive medical/dental/vision package * 401(k) with 4% employer match and 100% immediate vesting * 10 Floating Holidays * Company Paid Short\-Term Disability and Life Insurance * Paid Parental Leave * Tuition Assistance * Employee Ownership **Responsibilities:*** Technical Expertise and Design Leadership: * Perform advanced structural engineering analysis and design, applying standard and advanced engineering principles across complex projects. * Develop and implement improved techniques, procedures, and design solutions that enhance technical capabilities. * Review analyses and designs to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement. * Apply interdisciplinary engineering knowledge, including regulatory and permitting considerations. * Serve as a technical lead on multi\-discipline projects and may act as a Discipline Group Leader. * Project Management and Execution: * Manage or support multiple projects, overseeing scope, schedule, and quality of deliverables. * Coordinate detailed phases of engineering work and ensure alignment across project teams. * Estimate resource needs, assign tasks, and monitor progress to meet deadlines. * Provide leadership on project scope, objectives, budgets, and execution strategies. * Client and Team Collaboration: * Lead client meetings and serve as a representative of the firm. * Build and maintain strong client relationships to support ongoing and future work. * Collaborate with internal teams across disciplines to deliver integrated project solutions. * Mentor and guide junior staff, including reviewing work for QA/QC and supporting development. * Business Development and Ownership: * Support proposal development and contribute to competitive positioning of the firm. * Maintain and grow relationships with existing and prospective clients. * Contribute to internal and external technical knowledge sharing through training, presentations, or publications. **Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program or related field. * Licensed Professional Engineer (PE). * 10\+ years of experience in structural engineering. * Experience with hydroelectric, fisheries, or water resource projects preferred. * Specialized experience within structural engineering such as seismic design or finite element modeling is a plus. * Strong knowledge of engineering principles, standards, and codes applicable to structural engineering (e.g., AISC, IEEE, ASME). * Experience with analysis and design of concrete and steel structures, particularly in and around water environments. * Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams including hydrology/hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, and geotechnical engineers. * Proficiency with structural modeling and design software such as MathCAD, RISA\-3D, SAP2000, AutoCAD, and Revit. * Proficiency with CAD software and discipline\-specific engineering tools. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to manage projects and client relationships. * Experience working with clients and contractors during planning and construction phases. * Familiarity with regulatory and permitting processes is a plus. * Proven experience managing project teams, including junior and senior staff, drafters, and coordinators. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines. * Experience serving as a Project Manager and/or Technical Lead on multidisciplinary projects. * Experience preparing proposals and supporting business development efforts. * Ability to build and maintain long\-term client relationships and contribute to ongoing business development. * Passion for mentoring and jobs.title: AI Solutions Support Lead
jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry. At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations. **How does this role contribute to our collective success?** AI solutions are becoming increasingly important to AXIS' ability to drive efficiency, improve decision making, and enhance customer and employee experiences. As AI capabilities mature and move into production, maintaining their effectiveness, reliability, fairness, and business value becomes critical. The AI Solutions Support Lead is responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of AI solutions that have been deployed into production. Once an AI solution has been delivered and transitioned from the Data Science \& AI Delivery team, ownership of day\-to\-day operational support and continuous improvement will transfer to this role. Leading a team of AI engineers provided through our strategic delivery partners, the AI Solutions Support Lead will ensure production AI solutions remain stable, performant, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs. This role acts as the central coordination point between AI engineering, Data Science \& AI Delivery, Data Engineering, BTS, business stakeholders, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions continue to deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle. The role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership, requiring an individual who is equally comfortable discussing model performance, coordinating incident response activities, managing enhancement roadmaps, and engaging senior business stakeholders. **What will you do in this role?** Own Production AI Solutions * Assume operational ownership of AI solutions following successful deployment and handover from delivery teams. * Establish and maintain support processes, documentation, runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, defect management and operational procedures. once a solution has met agreed production acceptance criteria, including runbooks(those will need to be created and handed over to support team), monitoring dashboards, support ownership, escalation paths, defect management, and release evidence * Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and service management practices are in place for all production AI solutions. * Maintain an accurate inventory of supported solutions, dependencies, business owners, and support requirements. Lead AI Support \& Incident Management * Coordinate investigation and resolution of production issues affecting AI solutions. * Manage defect remediation activities and oversee the delivery of code fixes through internal and partner engineering teams. * Act as the primary point of coordination during major incidents impacting AI services. * Ensure issues are identified, triaged, prioritised, communicated, and resolved effectively. * Support post\-incident reviews and implementation of preventative actions. Monitor Solution Performance \& Effectiveness * Own monitoring frameworks to assess solution performance, reliability, usage, accuracy, cost, and value realization. * Monitor AI outputs for signs of performance degradation, model drift, bias, fairness concerns, or changing business effectiveness. * Ensure solutions continue to meet business objectives, operational requirements, and governance standards. * Identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvement activities. Drive Continuous Improvement \& Enhancements * Own and manage enhancement backlogs for production AI solutions. * Coordinate development and deployment of approved enhancements. * Ensure solutions evolve in line with changing business processes, regulatory expectations, and technology capabilities. * Support release planning and production deployments. Collaborate Across Technology \& Data Teams * Work closely with the broader Data Science \& AI Delivery team to ensure effective transition of solutions into support. * Partner with Data Engineering teams to maintain data pipelines, integrations, and platform dependen : * High availability and reliability of production AI solutions. * Timely resolution of incidents and defects. * Strong stakeholder satisfaction with AI services and support. * Evidence that AI solutions continue to deliver expected business outcomes. * Effective monitoring and management of performance, fairness, bias, drift, and operational risk. * Delivery of enhancements and continuous improvements aligned to business priorities. * Smooth transition of solutions from delivery into operational support. * Well\-managed support teams and partner resources. **About You** You are an organised, technically strong leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, operations, and business value. You have experience supporting complex production systems and can confidently coordinate multidisciplinary teams to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement. You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes. **Skills \& Experience** Essential * Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data\-driven solutions. * Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement. * Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third\-party delivery partners. * Strong incident management and problem\-solving capabilities. * Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions. * Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices. * Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. * Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. * Strong organisational and leadership capabilities. **Desirable** * Experience supporting Generative AI, machine learning, large language model (LLM), or agentic AI solutions. * Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies. * Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements. * Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices. **Working Arrangements** This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability. Given the critical nature of production support responsibilities, occasional out\-of\-hours work, including evenings and weekends, may be required to support incident resolution, production deployments, testing activities, or other business\-critical operational events. **Role Factors:** In this role, you will typically be required to: Attend your local office at least three (3\) days per week to meet and build relationships with colleagues and the wider business. Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture. **What we offer:** For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 \- $200,000 USD (New York, NY), $110,000 \- $130,000 CAD (Halifax, Nova Scotia) Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more. Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes. **This posting is for an existing vacancy.**

jobs.title: Field CTO - Data & Agentic Transformation, Google Cloud
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We're the Accenture Google Business Group Mid\-Market team, a specialized group of engineers, architects, and builders delivering tailored Google Cloud solutions for mid\-market, high\-growth, and fast\-paced enterprises. We partner with dynamic organizations to connect them with the right combination of Accenture solutions and Google Cloud products to accelerate business transformation and solve real\-world problems, quickly. We're expanding our team to meet the unique, rapid execution needs of the mid\-market segment. **The Domain** Data and AI are no longer back\-office functions — they're the engine of every modern business decision. And with the arrival of agentic AI, we're entering a new era: intelligent agents that don't just analyze data but act on it — automating complex workflows, making autonomous decisions, and transforming how companies operate. Google Cloud is leading this shift with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI, and the most powerful data stack in the industry. Our mid\-market clients need lean, agile leaders who can unlock massive amounts of untapped data and rapidly turn it into a distinct competitive advantage. **The Role** You're the person the client trusts to make it happen. As a Technical Delivery Lead, you own delivery from initial solution shaping through go\-live. You design the execution approach for data and AI engagements, lead the implementation, and ensure the final product fundamentally upgrades how the client leverages data and intelligent automation. You're supported by a dedicated offshore engineering team — you set the strategic direction, and they build alongside you. But you're the single point of accountability for what ships. This role is for an execution\-focused leader who takes full ownership of their work. You care deeply about delivery quality, data architecture outcomes, agent design, and speed\-to\-value for the business. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would. You'll work directly with client stakeholders — immersing yourself in their environment, understanding their fast\-evolving resource constraints, and delivering outcomes that matter in weeks, not quarters. You'll have the autonomy to shape how they experience the full power of Google Cloud's data and AI stack, from first conversation to go\-live. **What You'll Do** * **Own the delivery.** End\-to\-end. Scope, timeline, team structure, quality, outcome. You're the single point of accountability the client relies on. * **Design how it gets delivered.** Shape the delivery approach for complex data and AI engagements — define the delivery plan, phase the work, structure the team, and manage dependencies across data engineering, analytics, and AI workstreams. Partner with solution engineers who own the technical architecture; you own how it gets executed and shipped. * **Provide technical advisory across the engagement** — Guide our mid\-market clients and teams on our offerings, technical implementation, and the underlying Google Cloud services, with a deep understanding of each client's existing environment and architecture. * **Be the client's trusted delivery partner.** You're the face of the engagement. Lead status reviews, manage expectations, navigate trade\-offs in real time, and ensure the client always knows where things stand — especially when the work involves iterative AI development where scope evolves. * **Get solutions into clients' hands fast.** Pick up where the deal ends and make it real. Stand up the delivery, mobilize the team, and drive execution from day one — delivering proven capabilities in weeks, not quarters. * **Lead across borders.** Coordinate onshore delivery leadership with offshore engineering teams. Set priorities, define workstreams, remove blockers, and keep the entire delivery machine moving at pace. * **Drive quality and outcomes.** Establish delivery governance, define checkpoints, track progress against commitments, and ensure every engagement delivers measurable client value — from data platform readiness to AI models in production. **Technical Skills \& Domain Expertise** * Data Platforms \& Engineering: Advanced proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, Spanner, and Bigtable for data migration, modernization, pipeline design, data quality governance, and lakehouse architecture patterns. * Analytics \& Business Intelligence: Hands\-on experience executing Looker deployments, connected sheets integrations, real\-time operational dashboards, and semantic modeling. * Artificial Intelligence \& Machine Learning: Core understanding of Vertex AI, Gemini models, AutoML, custom model training, and building production\-grade MLOps deployment pipelines. * Agentic \& Generative AI Patterns: Working knowledge of modern agent orchestration patterns, including tool use, grounding mechanisms, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Development Kit (ADK), A2A protocol, and Mod al, vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer
jobs.description: Our client is an AI consulting and implementation company working exclusively within the Direct Selling industry. They help businesses move from AI curiosity to real AI capability by working closely with leadership teams. Their focus is on implementing practical AI solutions while building the tools, governance, and internal confidence clients need to continue progressing independently. They are looking for an **AI Agents \& Automations Engineer** with strong engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-ready AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different AI agent and automation frameworks and understands the importance of reliability, integrations, monitoring, error handling, and maintainability. The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Build the infrastructure around agents, including triggers, queues, error handling, retries, fallbacks and monitoring; * Define the access and infrastructure requirements for each solution, including credentials, permissions, data access, rate limits, service accounts and audit trails; * Design appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop processes where full automation is not suitable. **Agentic AI \& automation:** * Build solutions using different agent and automation frameworks such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Select the right framework and architecture based on the business problem rather than defaulting to a single technology; * Integrate AI agents with external APIs, business systems and data sources; * Turn successful one\-off client implementations into reusable patterns and components. **Client discovery \& solution design:** * Work directly with Operations, Sales, Support, Finance and other client teams to understand existing workflows and identify automation opportunities; * Determine which processes are worth automating and where AI agents can deliver measurable business value; * Translate non\-technical business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications; * Explain technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& continuous improvement:** * Document solutions and conduct handover sessions so client and internal teams can independently maintain what has been built; * Help establish reusable engineering standards and processes for AI agent and automation development; * Automate internal workflows and identify opportunities to improve how the company itself uses AI. ‍ #### **Requirements** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python or TypeScript; * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents / agentic workflows in production, not only prototypes or sandbox projects; * Hands\-on experience with several agent or automation technologies such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Confident working with APIs, integrations and webhooks; * Comfortable with production engineering topics including authentication, scopes, secrets management, logging, monitoring, cost control and API limitations; * Enough infrastructure knowledge to independently deploy and maintain the solutions you build; * Able to demonstrate 2–3 AI agents you have built and deployed with measurable business outcomes such as hours saved, reduced error rates, improved cycle times or revenue impact; * Strong client\-facing and discovery skills with the ability to communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders and turn business problems into technical solutions; * Advanced English level; * Pragmatic engineering mindset: able to choose a simple, reliable solution over unnecessary technical complexity. ### **Bonus points for** * Experience with AI evals, observability or agent monitoring; * Experience with RAG and vector databases; * Frontend development experience sufficient to build usable interfaces around AI solutions; * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration; * Security, data protection or compliance experience; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; * A permanent, fully remote role with a basic salary and the potential to participate in the share option scheme; * A seat at the table on how we evolve our methodology, our tooling and the way we work with clients. We want you shaping the playbook, not just following it.

jobs.title: CFD Engineer - AI Simulation Output Review (Remote)
jobs.description: CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) assignments. * Grade cfd engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * CFD Engineer engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.description: **Ref:** Permanent **Location:** Cork **Salary:** Negotiable **COMPANY INFO:** Headquartered in Cork and with offices in Limerick, London and Edinburgh, CField Construction is a privately owned Building \& Civil Engineering contractor that provides construction services to both private and public partners across a wide range of sectors in Ireland and the UK. jobs.description: **Title:** Senior Manager, Software Engineering**Level:** M3**Department:** CSI**Reports To:** VP, Software and Security**Revision Date:** 8/25/2026**FLSA Status:** Exempt**Location:** Orlando, FL **Company Overview** Comtech Telecommunications Corp. is a leading global technology company providing terrestrial and wireless network solutions, next\-generation 9\-1\-1 emergency services, satellite and space communications technologies, and cloud\-native capabilities to commercial and government customers around the world. Our unique culture of innovation and employee empowerment unleashes a relentless passion for customer success. With multiple facilities located in technology corridors throughout the United States and around the world, Comtech leverages our global presence, technology leadership, and decades of experience to create the world’s most innovative communications solutions. For more information, please visit www.comtech.com. We’re seeking curious, growth\-minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures, and systems; playing a key role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we’d love to have you apply. **Position Summary** The Senior Manager, Software Engineering provides strategic and technical leadership for software development teams building complex, high‑reliability communications and network products. This role is responsible for guiding engineering execution, scaling best‑in‑class development practices, enabling cross‑functional alignment, and driving product readiness from concept through delivery. The Senior Manager will manage multiple engineering teams, mentor technical leaders, and ensure the organization consistently meets quality, performance, and delivery expectations. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities*** Technical Leadership \& Strategy * Develop and communicate a clear technical vision aligned with company and product objectives. * Drive architecture, design, development, and integration of advanced software systems, platforms, and applications. * Collaborate closely with Product, Systems, Hardware, and R\&D organizations to define requirements, roadmaps, and release plans. * Provide expert guidance in modern software engineering methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud‑native development. * Team Leadership \& People Management + Lead multiple software engineering teams, including managers, senior engineers, and cross‑disciplinary contributors. + Coach and mentor engineering managers and technical leads to elevate performance and technical depth. + Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑accountability culture that encourages creativity, ownership, and continuous improvement. + Partner with People Operations on workforce planning, hiring, and development initiatives. * Execution \& Delivery + Ensure engineering teams deliver on schedule, scope, quality, and performance expectations. + Drive rigorous testing, verification, and readiness processes for all releases. + Remove impediments, optimize workflows, and implement scalable development standards across teams. + Oversee software documentation, release notes, and compliance requirements. * Cross‑Functional Collaboration + Work with Customer Support, Systems Engineering, Field Engineering, and Sales Engineering to ensure customer needs and product requirements are met. + Serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. + Participate in customer meetings, technical reviews, and professional services engagements as necessary. * Operational Excellence + Oversee engineering lab environments, tools, infrastructure, and development resources. + Establish metrics, dashboards, and governance processes that track productivity, code quality, velocity, and reliability. + Promote strong security, safety, and compliance practices across all development activities. **Qualifications*** Proven expertise developing high‑availability, distributed, or systems‑level software products. * Experience with modern programming languages (e.g., C/C\+\+, Python, Java), cloud technologies, networking concepts, or satellite/communications systems. * Strong project management, planning, and organizational skills. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to interface across engineering, leadership, and customer environments. **Desired Qualifications*** Experience with RF systems, satellite communications, or embedded software. * Familiarity with secure coding practices and zero‑trust environments. * Experience leading multi‑site or global engineering teams. * Prior work with database systems, analytics tools, or cloud infrastructure. **Education*** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Master’s degree preferred **Experience*** 10\+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 3\+ years leading engineering teams. **About Us****This position requires compliance with Comtech’s Drug\-Free Workplace Program. Candidates must successfully complete a pre\-employment drug screening as a condition of hire. Employees may be subject to random, reasonable suspicion, and post\-incident testing. Illegal drug use — including marijuana, regardless of state law — is disqualifying under federal adjudicative guidelines and DoD DFARS requirements.** **The pay range reflects the expected base salary for this position. Final compensation will be based on role, level, skills, experience, and geographic location.** **Comtech Telecommunications Corp. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.**

jobs.description: Remote Contract (6 months 7 days) Published 7 hours ago technical documentation Logging \& Monitoring pyspark data engineering SQL DevOps \& CI/CD dbt Certification metadata management databricks * We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer / Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in Databricks and dbt (Data Build Tool) to support the implementation of enterprise data pipelines on a modern cloud\-based data platform. * The role will be responsible for defining and implementing scalable data engineering patterns using Databricks and dbt, establishing development standards and reusable frameworks, and providing hands\-on technical guidance to the data engineering team. * The candidate will work closely with architecture, DevOps, Data Governance, and delivery teams to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. **Key Responsibilities:** * Define the technical architecture and implementation patterns for dbt\-based data transformations on Databricks. * Design and develop scalable curated and consumption\-layer data pipelines using Databricks and dbt. * Establish dbt project structure, model organization, dependencies, naming conventions, coding standards, and reusable development patterns. * Define and implement appropriate usage of dbt models, sources, tests, macros, snapshots, incremental models, packages, and documentation. * Design efficient transformation patterns leveraging Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, and PySpark. * Establish reusable and standardized pipeline development patterns for adoption across the engineering team. * Work with architecture teams to ensure implementation aligns with enterprise architecture, governance, security, and data\-platform standards. * Provide hands\-on development support and technical guidance to Data Engineers. * Review existing data transformation and pipeline patterns and determine the appropriate implementation using Databricks and dbt. * Define data quality, reconciliation, testing, logging, monitoring, and error\-handling approaches. * Design and implement appropriate incremental data\-processing strategies. * Support performance optimization and troubleshooting of dbt models and Databricks workloads. * Work with DevOps teams to integrate dbt and Databricks development into the enterprise CI/CD framework. * Support orchestration and scheduling integration with Databricks Workflows and enterprise scheduling platforms. * Conduct technical design reviews and code reviews and ensure adherence to defined engineering standards. * Support testing, deployment, production readiness, and troubleshooting activities. * Develop reusable templates, frameworks, utilities, and implementation guidelines to accelerate development. * Prepare technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer to engineering and support teams. * Mentor Data Engineers and provide technical leadership throughout design, development, testing, and deployment. **Required Skills \& Experience:** * 8\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or related areas. * Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks. * Strong hands\-on experience implementing enterprise data solutions using dbt. * Strong understanding of dbt models, sources, macros, tests, snapshots, incremental models, packages, and documentation. * Strong programming and development skills in SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark. * Strong experience with Delta Lake and Databricks data\-engineering capabilities. * Experience designing and implementing Medallion Architecture / multi\-layered data platforms. * Strong understanding of logical and physical data modeling concepts. * Experience building scalable, reusable, and metadata\-driven data\-engineering solutions. * Experience implementing data\-quality, validation, reconciliation, lineage, monitoring, and observability capabilities. * Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices for dbt and Databricks. * Experience with Git\-based source control and automated deployment processes. * Strong understanding of performance optimization and troubleshooting of large\-scale data pipelines. * Ability to translate architecture standards and business requirements into practical engineering solutions. * Experience conducting technical design and code reviews. * Ability to mentor and provide technical direction to Data Engineers. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills. **Preferred Skills:** * Databricks certification. * dbt certification or significant production implementation experience. * Experience with AWS\-based Databricks environments. * Experience with enterprise data governance, metadata management, lineage, and data\-product concepts. * Experience with Control\-M or other enterprise workload scheduling/orchestration platforms. * Experience working on large\-scale enterprise data\-platform transformation programs. The pay range that the employer in good faith reasonably expects to pay for this position is $46\.23/hour \- $72\.23/hour. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis. Tundra Technical Solutions is among North America’s leading providers of Staffing and Consulting Services. Our success and our clients’ success are built on a foundation of service excellence. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Unincorporated LA County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: client provided property, including hardware (both of which may include data) entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all portable client computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon completion of the assignment, and; maintain the confidentiality of client proprietary, confidential, or non\-public information. Functions, App Service and/or container\-based deployments * SQL and NoSQL databases * Redis or comparable distributed caching technologies * OAuth 2\.0, OIDC and JWT * Event\-driven application architecture * Observability and distributed tracing * Automated testing * CI/CD pipelines * Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Dataverse API integration **Preferred Background** Additional value would come patterns * Integrating CRM platforms with document, analytics, data or workflow systems * Secure or regulated enterprise environments * Cloud\-native application development Pay: $106,342\.23 \- jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Digital Consumer
jobs.description: As a Senior Full Stack Engineer within our digital engineering team, you help design and deliver customer facing digital applications at scale, building the experiences that bring Chubb Personal Risk Services’ promise to life for the agents who champion our clients, the clients who trust us, and the internal teams who deliver on that trust every day. With us, you will be a hands on contributor and key owner of partner integrations and new insurance product capabilities, developing robust solutions across the full stack, web, mobile, and APIs. You bring strong engineering discipline, a security first mindset, and a genuine obsession for customer experience in a globally connected environment where the best digital experiences are fast, intuitive, secure, and reliable. That is the standard we are setting for PRS, and you will play a key role in helping us deliver it. If you have spent your career focused on what makes digital products feel effortless and understand what it takes to make a premier brand feel premier in every interaction, we’d love to talk. **In this role, you will:** * Design, develop, and own Full Stack features and services using .NET (backend) and Angular (frontend), with a focus on performance, availability, and security * Lead delivery of partner integrations and new insurance product capabilities within the Digital Group * Build and ship customer\-facing applications that prioritize usability, reliability, and end\-to\-end experience quality * Leverage AI\-assisted development tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI\-driven code review and test generation) to accelerate SDLC velocity and code quality * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions * Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior and mid\-level engineers on the team * Architect and deploy cloud\-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, applying best practices for scalability, security, and global availability * Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to software development standards * 8–10 years of Full Stack engineering experience * Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline * Demonstrated strength in both .NET and Angular preferred * Proven track record delivering customer facing digital products in insurance, retail, hospitality, or consumer goods * Solid grasp of software engineering principles including design patterns, API design, testing strategies, and secure coding practices * Experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud native development patterns * Familiarity with AI assisted development tools that accelerate the software delivery lifecycle * Demonstrated ability to lead or mentor a small engineering team in a fast paced, agile environment Ability to collaborate across global time zones * The pay range for the role is $160,000 to $180,000\. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website . The company is distinguished by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength, underwriting excellence, superior claims handling expertise and local operations globally. jobs.title: Construction Project Executive
jobs.description: **Construction Project Executive** Coakley \& Williams Construction (CWC) is seeking a Project Executive to lead our commercial construction projects while helping expand our portfolio. Building on CWCs established commercial business this leader will strengthen client relationships, develop new opportunities, and partner directly with the Business Unit Leaders and COO on pursuits and growth strategy. The role offers meaningful authority over project selection, staffing, and execution, with a potential path to Business Unit Leader or senior operations leadership. Expertise representing a general contractor on multiple base building, ground up, complex renovation and other related construction projects in excess of $20 Million in Value is necessary. **What Youll Do*** Provide executive leadership for multiple commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout. * Develop and maintain relationships with institutional owners, industry leaders, architects, engineers, consultants, and trade subcontractors. * Identify and advance new opportunities while serving as a final reviewer of project pursuits, proposals, RFP responses, and interview strategies. * Partner directly with the business leaders on growth strategy, market positioning, and pursuit decisions. * Lead project teams and oversee safety, scheduling, procurement, quality, risk, subcontractor performance, and client communication. * Manage budgets, forecasts, change orders, cost controls, owner requisitions, and overall project profitability. * Guide constructability, phasing, logistics, estimating, scheduling, BIM, and value\-management decisions during preconstruction. * Help select, mentor, and develop project team members with support from CWCs experienced Talent Acquisition team. * Represent CWC within higher education and construction industry organizations, conferences, and networking events. **What Sets This Opportunity Apart*** Build on an established commercial and related construction platform while helping shape CWCs growing portfolio. * Influence which projects CWC pursues and how teams are assembled to deliver them. * Work directly with the business unit leaders on business\-line strategy, client development, and long\-term growth. * Gain executive visibility and a potential path to Business Unit Leader or senior operations leadership. * Join a mid\-sized commercial general contractor where senior leaders have the resources to execute and the access to make an impact. **Required Qualifications*** At least ten (10\) years of experience in managing building construction projects singularly, or in cumulative, in excess of Twenty (20\) Million Dollars * Bachelors Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or Related field * Experience developing business and maintaining long\-term client relationships within the educational and institutional construction market * Proven track record of client satisfaction and profitability * OSHA 30 hour, First Aid and CPR certifications * LEED Specialty Accreditation * Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, Procore, Bluebeam as well as an understanding of Primavera scheduling and BIM **Preferred Experience*** Leadership of new construction, base building, renovation, reconstruction, or preconstruction projects for life science and/or related customers * An established network of institutional owners, facilities leaders, design partners, consultants, and industry professionals * Experience managing occupied campuses, phased construction, academic calendar constraints, and complex stakeholder groups **Job Demands**This position requires the ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, reach, and lift or move items weighing up to 50 pounds. Work may involve active construction sites, heavy equipment, hazardous materials, and extreme weather conditions. Hours will vary based on project requirements and may include nights and weekends. CWC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. and operational transformation **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Consistent top performer with a track record of exceeding quota and winning new business * Experience selling complex software solutions into mid\-market and enterprise customers * Executive presence and comfort engaging senior business leaders * Experience selling horizontal platforms, workflow automation, AI\-native products, or operational transformation solutions * Ability to generate pipeline and create opportunities, not simply work inbound demand * Comfortable operating in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments with evolving processes * Strong business acumen and consultative selling skills * Demonstrated curiosity around AI, automation, and emerging technologies **Ideal Background** -------------------- * Experience scaling with a Series A, Series B, or early Series C company during a period of rapid growth * History of selling for challenger brands where success depended on product, execution, and creativity rather than company reputation * Experience navigating multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles * Background selling platforms that can be applied across multiple capabilities. * Support development of data modernization strategies involving Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, cloud data platforms, data integration, analytics, governance, and AI readiness. * Help define success criteria an ation. * Assist Project Managers in defining scope, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, and deliverables. * Identify scope changes and requirements that may impact project user documentation and training requirements. * Support stakeholder communication and adoption activities. * Help identify organizational barriers to adoption and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. * Assist customers with transitioning from legacy reporting and manual processes to new enterprise data and analytics capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in discovery sessions and stakeholder workshops. * Experience documenting business processes, functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Experience working with technical implementation teams. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical requirements. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong documentation and organizational skills. * Experience working with structured data, reporting, analytics, or business intelligence solutions. * Understanding of data integration, data quality, analytics, and data governance concepts. * Experience working with executive, business, and technical stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple requirements, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting data modernization, cloud migration, data warehouse, data lake, analytics, or digital\-transformation initiatives. * jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: **Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** **10% Equity \| PropTech \+ AI \| Founding Team** **The Opportunity** **We are assembling the founding team behind a new company designed to challenge one of the largest and most established consumer industries in America.** **We aren’t ready to publicly share everything we’re building.** **But we can share the thesis:** **AI is about to dramatically change the economics of selling a home. We intend to be ahead of that change.** **We are building a national real estate platform that combines AI\-powered listing technology, transparent flat\-fee services, and an optional layer of in\-person support into a fundamentally different consumer experience.** **Not another lead\-generation company.** **Not another CRM.** **Not another slightly cheaper version of a traditional brokerage.** **Something different.** **And we’re looking for the Founding CTO who wants to build it with us.** **Why This Is Interesting** **Most startups entering real estate eventually encounter the same problem:** **They can build the technology.** **They can raise money.** **They can generate demand.** **But actually operating a brokerage nationally introduces an enormous regulatory and licensing challenge.** **We have an opportunity to approach the market with licensing capabilities across all 50 states from the beginning.** **That changes what can be built.** **Instead of proving a concept in one state and spending years assembling the infrastructure required to expand, our ambition is national from day one.** **Combine that with experienced leadership, strong sales capabilities, direct industry knowledge and a business model that has already attracted significant interest from venture capital, private industry and strategic players, and we believe the ingredients exist to build something unusually large.** **What We’re Building** **We won’t publish the entire product roadmap here.** **The broader vision is straightforward:** **Flat\-fee real estate \+ AI listing technology \+ optional in\-person services.** **We believe homeowners should be able to use technology to handle significantly more of the home\-selling process themselves while having professional assistance available exactly when they need it.** **That means rethinking the entire experience rather than simply digitizing the traditional one.** **The technology could ultimately touch areas including:** **\* AI\-assisted property listing** **\* Pricing and market intelligence** **\* Listing distribution** **\* Marketing automation** **\* Transaction management** **\* Consumer guidance** **\* Showing coordination** **\* Document workflows** **\* Communications** **\* Brokerage operations** **\* Marketplace/service infrastructure** **\* Local, on\-demand assistance** **Some of what we intend to build is obvious.** **Some of it isn’t.** **The latter is a major reason we’re intentionally keeping this description broad.** **Your Role** **You would join as our Founding Chief Technology Officer and a true equity partner.** **This is not a position where someone else hands you a finished product specification and asks you to manage engineers.** **You will help determine what the product becomes.** **You’ll work directly with the founding team to translate a significant industry opportunity into a technology platform capable of operating nationally.** **Early on, you’ll be a builder.** **You’ll architect.** **You’ll prototype.** **You’ll write code.** **You’ll experiment with AI.** **You’ll decide what we build internally and what we integrate.** **You’ll probably kill some ideas and discover better ones.** **As the company grows, you’ll build the engineering organization around the architecture and technical vision you helped establish.** **The Technical Challenge** **We aren’t looking to sprinkle AI on top of an existing brokerage model and call it innovation.** **The question we’re interested in is much larger:** **If you were designing the process of selling a home today, with modern AI, automation and software available from the beginning, how much of the traditional model would you actually recreate?** **That’s the problem we want our CTO thinking about.** **The platform will require a combination of sophisticated consumer software, AI systems, real estate data, APIs, transaction infrastructure, brokerage operations and automation.** **And there is substantial room for the CTO to influence how those pieces come together.** **Who We’re Looking For** **We’re looking for a technical founder, not simply an employee with a CTO title.** **Someone who can move between architecture and execution.** **Someone who can build the first version and eventually recruit the people capable of building the hundredth.** **Experience with several of the following would be valuable:** **\* Full\-stack application development** **\* AI/LLM systems** **\* Agentic AI and automation** **\* API architecture** **\* Cloud infrastructure** **\* Data\-intensive applications** **\* SaaS platforms** **\* Marketplaces** **\* FinTech or PropTech** **\* Payments** **\* Security and privacy** **\* Real estate/MLS data** **\* Scaling engineering organizations** **Real estate experience is helpful, but not necessary.** **The ability to build quickly, think independently and recognize enormous technical leverage is.** **Why Join Now?** **Because the most interesting time to join a company isn’t after everything is obvious.** **It’s before.** **The founding team brings experience across real estate, brokerage operations, strategy, sales, marketing, product development and company growth.** **We have a significant structural advantage that would be difficult for a new entrant to reproduce quickly.** **We have a defined market thesis.** **We have a clear vision.** **And we are intentionally leaving one major seat at the founding table open:** **Technology.** **The person who fills it won’t inherit the technical strategy.** **They’ll create it.** **Compensation** **This is an equity\-first founding opportunity.** **Founding CTO Equity: 10%** **That’s meaningful ownership because we want meaningful commitment.** **We aren’t looking for someone to spend a few hours each week advising us from the sidelines. We want someone who wants to become one of the people who built the company.** **The equity structure would be formally documented with appropriate founder vesting and protections.** **As funding and/or revenue support it, the position is intended to evolve into a compensated executive role while retaining the CTO’s meaningful ownership position.** **The Bigger Picture** **The residential real estate industry represents an enormous amount of consumer spending.** **Technology has changed almost everything surrounding the transaction.** **Search changed.** **Marketing changed.** **Mortgage technology changed.** **Consumer behavior changed.** **And now AI is changing what consumers can reasonably do for themselves.** **We believe that creates a window for a very different kind of real estate company.** **One that combines technology, national brokerage infrastructure and real\-world services rather than choosing between them.** **We have a very specific vision for what that company can become.** **We’re intentionally not putting all of it in a job posting.** **If you’re the kind of technical founder who sees a massive legacy industry and immediately starts wondering how much of it can be rebuilt, we’d like to show you the rest.** Employment Type Pay: $60\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Expected hours: 1\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

mobile applications with RESTful APIs and cloud\-based services. * Knowledge of mobile data storage technologies such as SQLite, Room, Core Data, or similar frameworks. * Working knowledge of
